primary_access.result: Official German full text accessible through web reader, 836 lines; paragraphs61 and66–68 directly read, not merely a search snippet.

assessment: There is an affirmative narrow discrepancy: paragraph61 expressly leaves discussion of calculation method and the most representative groundwater network unnecessary, because undisputed coastal eutrophication already proves additional measures were needed. It does not expressly decide that monitoring-network dispute.

However, the author attributes a general quality standard to the judgment, rather than saying the Court selected a particular network. Paragraph7 quotes the duty to establish suitable monitoring; paragraph111 requires the best available science and regional characteristics; paragraphs118–120 accept the Commission’s context-specific criticism of unrepresentative scientific studies. These passages support an inferential evidentiary-quality reading, even though they are not an express monitoring-design holding in60ff.

The absence of an exact three-adjective formulation alone is insufficient to prove a source-description error. The word expressly makes a narrow attribution issue plausible, but a fair doctrinal summary remains a substantial benign alternative.

Paragraph66 permits forecasts with stated uncertainties, but this does not refute the author’s narrower assertion that Germany cannot rely on models when actual data show otherwise. The Court rejects delaying review beyond four years; paragraphs67–69 support empirical accountability. Do not treat this as a categorical anti-model claim.
The author expressly endorses appropriate modelling elsewhere, including on page4. A claim that Taube opposes all models would misread the surrounding context.

The requested farm-gate data and wider monitoring proposals are unambiguous, but whether those particular methods are legally required or scientifically superior is not established by this source check.
severity_and_direction: If the editor retains only an express-holding miscitation, minor/true is defensible: extra judicial authority supports the request. My conservative recommendation is an unresolved source-description lead unless the final record makes a sharper literal claim than a general quality-standard attribution. No major finding warranted.
limits: No specialist review, no ruling on present German compliance, no assessment of farm-gate accounting policy merits, no new author quotations reproduced.
